goal: Research how routes() exposes the payment service and write docs/research/routes-shape.md. Every claim carries a provenance tag.

rubric.text: Unknowns are listed as [unknown] with "resolve by", never guessed.
Citations point at file:line ranges that exist.

The Recommendation and Confidence rest on the tagged findings: the recommendation acts on findings it names (F-ids) or restates, and neither adds a factual claim that no finding or unknown carries. A recommendation built on an untagged claim scores 0.

Every source the document cites is one the session actually read or fetched: each [verified: path:START-END] path, each [docs: URL @ version] URL and each ## Sources entry appears among the session's Read, Grep or Glob calls, its WebFetch or WebSearch calls, or its Bash commands (the read-log and bash-log data). A source the session never read or fetched is invented and scores 0, even when the page or file exists.
